sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 37 = check 36; Internal Quality Checks row 37; no cell comments on either)
evidence:
Manual application of check 36 / check-probe-not-in-seed.py (the private checker was not executed). SEED: task/environment/assets/seed_data.json is {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. ..."}, so no record, title, filename or source exists that a probe could collide with; the golden server.js contains no seeding INSERT (only POST/PUT/restore handlers and a schema migration) and solve.sh does not import a seed. REFERENCE INITIAL STATE: app.tsx:22-24 initial draft is useState(''), filename 'snippet.js', title 'Untitled'; app.tsx:27 snippets []; app.tsx:32 console entries []; app.tsx:33 status 'Ready'; the built bundle public/assets/index.js carries the same initial values. The only authored content the reference ever supplies is the New starter (app.tsx:99: 'document.body.innerHTML = "

Hello, Colderwater

";\nconsole.log("Ready to explore.");'), which the public note permits ('New drafts start empty or with a small example', overview.md:3). PROBES: across the 3 gate, 42 functional, 6 polish and 3 visual criteria every mutation-proving value is chosen by the judge at run time and worded as distinctive/unique ('exact unique title, filename and source', 'unique title', 'distinctive marker', 'distinctive hostile marker', 'fresh marker', 'distinctive key and value'); functional/prompt.md adds 'You may choose the exact fixture text for each criterion. Check that the editor holds it before acting.' and app_context.md says 'the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library'. The one hard-coded probe literal is 'MULTI' (cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic); grep -r 'MULTI' over task/solution returns zero hits in src, static, index.html and the built bundle, and it is typed into a judge-authored fixture with 'nowhere else' checked. The hostile-marker targets are clean in the reference: the page title is the static 'Colderwater Playground' (index.html), the reference's own localStorage keys are cw-width-v2/cw-height-v2, and the library is empty at start. cw_basic_run_output explicitly says 'clear the draft' before typing, so the New starter cannot satisfy it. Scripted golden results on these bytes (results/persist-before.json, hash verified) pass the save/stale/history/live criteria using per-run stamped titles, consistent with an empty starting library; no configured judge run exists for these bytes, and none is needed to decide this static row. NOTES (not defects, P3): (a) cw_basic_run_output uses a deliberately non-distinctive probe ('two small integers you choose ... the app console must contain it'); the reference console pane heading renders '03 / Console ' (app.tsx:170) and the footer shows '5s run budget', so a one-digit sum could be matched loosely against chrome by a careless judge. The preview half of the same conjunction and the second-run changed sum bound this. (b) Several criteria save a snippet without asking for a unique title (cw_preview_isolation 'save one snippet and confirm ... its library entry is shown', cw_stale_save_refused 'Save a snippet', cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft, cw_unsaved_marker); the reference pre-fills the title with 'Untitled' and lists library entries by title and filename only (app.tsx:160), so a judge that keeps the default can see an older identical 'Untitled / snippet.js' entry from an earlier criterion and treat the library-entry control as shown. This is a state left by earlier grading, not the seed or the reference's initial state, and app_context warns about earlier records; it belongs mainly to row 37.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening only: in cw_basic_run_output ask for a sum of at least three digits (for example two three-digit integers), and add 'with a unique title' to the Save steps of cw_preview_isolation, cw_stale_save_refused, cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft and cw_unsaved_marker.
